selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with a thick-walled, anechoic lesion and low-level internal echoes, along with the presence of turbid fluid upon aspiration, supports the diagnosis of an infected non-parasitic cyst, which is further confirmed by the contrast-enhanced CT findings.

rejected.label: Simple Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: The presence of infection and thick-walled lesion does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hepatic Abscess
rejected.why: Although similar, the specific description of a cystic lesion with a solid component better fits the champion diagnosis

rejected.label: Infected Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less specific compared to infected non-parasitic cyst
